title: FreePBX security advisory (AV26-973)
content_md: Serial number: AV26-973 Date: September 29, 2026 As of September 28, 2026, FreePBX is affected by vulnerabilities in the following products: music Prior to 16.0.4 Prior to 17.0.6 ucp Prior to 16.0.39 Prior to 17.0.6 soundlang Prior to 17.0.5 Prior to 16.0.10 backup Prior to 16.0.72 Prior to 17.0.7 superfecta Prior to 16.0.40 Prior to 17.0.7 api Prior to 17.0.9 The Cyber Centre encourages users and administrators to review the provided web link and apply any necessary updates as they become available. FreePBX Security Advisories Article Link: FreePBX security advisory (AV26-973) - Canadian Centre for Cyber Security
